understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level while avoiding spike tiles and completing the game within the available attempts and turns.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally, after which gravity carries the player until landing or encountering a hazard or goal. Gravity direction determines whether the player falls toward smaller or larger y-values. CLICK removes a clickable breakable tile at the specified coordinates without moving the player, while UNDO can revert the previous action. Landing on spikes ends the attempt, and each level provides two attempts with up to 50 turns each.
